animejs_named: text-appear: words/chars x [.35em, 0], opacity [0,1], 1000ms, outQuint, stagger 25ms eased outIn(2)
scramble-out: chars opacity 0, scaleX 0, 100ms, stagger 25ms from last ease in(3)
scramble-in: chars opacity [0,1], scaleX [0,1], x [10,0], 150ms, stagger 25ms from first ease in(3) start 100
anything dot x: dot slides x [-wordWidth, 0], scaleX [8,1] (stretch then settle), duration chars*25+75, out(3); words cycle HTML > WebGL > CSS > Canvas 2D > SVG > anything, 750ms gap
staggering: 13x13 grid, scale [1, stagger [15,1] from center, 1], x/y ripple, 750ms loop inOutQuad, stagger 200 from center ease in
grid circles intro: scale 0->4->1, opacity stagger [.5,0] from center out(2), 400ms out(3), delay stagger 100 from center
bg path flicker: opacity [0,1,0,1,0,1] 200ms steps(5), random delay 0-800
draggable: hover scale 1.15 / grab .8 / release 1, all 350ms out(3); release ease spring(120,6)
draw: svg path draw ['0 0','0 1'] 1000ms inOutExpo; car follows motion path 10000ms linear loop
clockwork-enter: ticks scaleY 1.5 (every 12th 2.25) 350ms; leave scaleY 1 250ms; playhead rotate 360 1920ms linear
feature swap: demo opacity 250ms inOut(3), text opacity .5<->1 250ms out(3), list hide 250ms delay 150
card show/hide: y '120%' -> 0, opacity, 350ms inOut(3) in, 250ms out
label lines: draw ['0 1','0 0'] 250ms out(3) stagger 10; labels opacity+scale [0,1] 200ms inOut(2) stagger 10
scene: rotateY -720 1625ms; z / rotateX moves 1000-2000ms inOut(3); colour cross-fade 2500-3000ms
ambient: mesh rotateZ -360 32000-64000ms linear loop; cylinder rotateY 10000ms
scroll sync: onScroll sync .9 (smoothed scrub), enter 'top top' leave 'bottom bottom', pinned chapters
css_keyframes: motion.dev home-diag-row: 0-30% x0 o1 / 55-70% x-12% o0 / 85-100% x0 o1, 3s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) infinite
motion.dev home-diag-translate: 0-12% rest, 34-44% translate(120px) rotate(15deg), 3.6s cubic-bezier(.6,0,.2,1) infinite
kokonut home-enter: from opacity 0, blur(2px), translateY(6px); 0.3s cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1) both; waves of 0 / .05 / .1s; reduced motion: 0.15s fade
v0 slowBounce: translateY -15% <-> 0 with in/out curves
v0 pulseBorder: border + 2px ring flash, 1.25s ease-out
v0 mask-reveal: mask-position -> 0% center, 1s ease forwards
v0 drawAndErase: stroke-dashoffset 2 -> 1 (30%) hold -> 0 (96%), 1.5s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) infinite
v0 keypressEffect: background flash -> transparent, 1s ease-out
bklit page-fade-in/out, scroll-fade mask on edges of horizontal scrollers
